from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone,timedelta
import json,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();out=root/"reports/research/510300_manufacturing_demand_constraint_survey_source_v1"
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
stamp=datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))).isoformat()
protocol={
 "study_id":"510300_MANUFACTURING_DEMAND_CONSTRAINT_SURVEY_SOURCE_V1","experiment_id":"E62","registered_at":stamp,
 "status":"REGISTERED_TWO_ORIGINAL_MONTHS_EXACT_DEMAND_CONSTRAINT_SURVEY_SOURCE_BEFORE_SEARCH",
 "why":"E60原2022-07只说需求不足企业超过五成，2022-08另有成本高企业精确48.4%；企业报告困难的比例可能提供比PMI水平更直接的原因量。E61同值方向反例完成，不将七原收益转为原因交易分类。",
 "question":"原2022-07/08联合PMI发布机构中国物流与采购联合会的当月解释，是否给出同制造业调查的市场需求不足企业精确占比，字段定义和原公开时钟是什么。",
 "fixed_target_months":["2022-07","2022-08"],"fixed_field":"反映市场需求不足的制造业企业占比（百分比）",
 "source_rule":"只实际官方chinawuliu.com.cn当月PMI报告/专家解读原URL；两个实际官方查询/最多两个原GET，先保存选择URL。不是转去新闻转载、其他月份或地区。不猜ID/模板、不读项目凭据，不重试/重定向。",
 "unit_and_identity":"占比是回应问题的企业百分比，不是新订单扩散值或PMI、不一定互斥选项；统计总体和联合当月发布关系须原文可辨，不仅凭数值相同推母体。",
 "no_backfill":"只原当月直接精确值。超过五成保留>50上界/下界信息、不能填50；后月同比/月差回算前月不作为前月当时已知值；其他成本比例不替代需求比例。",
 "clock":"原成文/发布/显示分钟/URL归档/今日收件分开，日内未知保持UNKNOWN；首版未认证不能冒称严格当时版本。",
 "prior_use_search_scope":["research","config","docs"],
 "finite_prior_use_terms":["反映市场需求不足的企业占比","需求不足企业占比","市场需求不足.*企业.*比重"],
 "network_budget":{"official_queries":2,"original_GETs":2,"retries":0,"redirects":0,"authenticated":0},
 "model_budget":0,"new_label_budget":0,"account_budget":0,"source_code_edit_budget":0,
 "source_gate":"两原月直接精确同义字段与身份/钟未建立时保持未准入；有限两月通过也不等于完整1711成员来源或股票效应，须另有全原支持协议。",
 "economic_hypothesis_rejected":False,"old_E38_and_E51_E56_rejections_preserved":True,
 "current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET","orders_authorized":False,"net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False}
(out/"protocol.json").write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
r=subprocess.run(["rg","-n","--max-count","2","反映市场需求不足的企业占比|需求不足企业占比|市场需求不足.*企业.*比重","research","config","docs"],capture_output=True,text=True,encoding="utf-8")
(out/"实际有限旧用途定位.json").write_text(json.dumps({"at":stamp,"command_scope":protocol["prior_use_search_scope"],"exit_code":r.returncode,"matches":r.stdout,"stderr":r.stderr,"limits":"实际有限范围，出现背景/叙述不等于原同字段模型用途；无命中不证明全历史未试，当前尚未登记模型。"},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"protocol":str(out/"protocol.json"),"prior_use_matches":r.stdout[:4500],"rc":r.returncode,"new_queries":2,"new_GET_budget":2},ensure_ascii=False))
